scope: isolated reference-application subprocesses, real SQLite files and loopback HTTP protocol harness; no wallet or chain operation
checks: business intent committed before any HTTP and retained across application processes
changed intent or confirmation threshold rejected before HTTP
SQLite triggers reject business identity, intent, digest or threshold updates and identity deletion
successful wrong-intent response cannot overwrite saved state or mark paid
pay calls existing retry exactly once; dropped response retains binding and last state
paid requires confirmed matching transaction observation and bound confirmation threshold
caller process death retains original identity and unfinished attempt
proxy environment ignored and HTTP redirects refused
